findings.issue: את marks כל אלה as the object of 3cp עשו (they did all these). todas estas hicieron makes those demonstratives the subject who did the action.
אלה is common plural and כל is masculine singular construct; todas estas specifies feminine plural.

notes: 2mp תלכו as andarán is ustedes address; participle enviando and en ellos keep the token structure.
